mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_stocktake WHERE stocktake_no = #{stocktakeNo} AND deleted = FALSE
SELECT * FROM inventory_stocktake WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
SELECT * FROM inventory_stocktake WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_stocktake SET status = 'CONFIRMED', confirmed_at = #{confirmedAt}, operator = #{operator}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{operator} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE AND status = 'DRAFT'
UPDATE inventory_stocktake SET status = 'CANCELLED', version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{operator} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE AND status = 'DRAFT'

UPDATE inventory_stocktake SET warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}, remark = #{remark}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{operator} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE AND status = 'DRAFT'
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.stocktake_no, s.warehouse_id, s.status, s.remark, s.confirmed_at, s.operator, s.version, s.created_at, s.updated_at, w.warehouse_code, w.name AS warehouse_name FROM inventory_stocktake s LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = s.warehouse_id WHERE s.deleted = FALSE AND s.id = #{id}
